programs.title: Living Black
programs.desc: Vanessa Turnbull-Roberts proudly wears her heart on her sleeve. Karla Grant asks about her experiences in the NSW foster system, why more change is needed, and where she's found joy as a mother.

programs.title: Lady In The Water
programs.desc: Apartment building superintendent Cleveland Heep (Giamatti) rescues what he thinks is a young woman from the pool he maintains. When he discovers that she is actually a character from a bedtime story who is trying to make the journey back to her home, he works with his tenants to protect his new friend from the creatures that are determined to keep her in our world.

programs.title: Melanin
programs.desc: Across the world, from Paris to Los Angeles via the steps of the Cannes festival, actress and director Aïssa Maïga questions the way black women are represented on-screen and how diversity is promoted. With personal accounts from Adèle Haenel, Ava DuVernay, Tais Araujo, Firmine Richard, Sonia Rolland...\nDirected by: Aïssa Maïga, Isabelle Simeoni (France, 2021).
